digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding lifecycle config ownership drain
propositions: binding_lifecycle.py contains two config-ownership exceptions: RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE read and os.environ.get shim, both originally from binding_store.py but moved during RP-02 S2 and not yet cut
resolve_absent_retire_grace() already exists as a public facade accessor in rebar.config with byte-identical semantics to the local _env_int shim (default 3, clamp >= 1, malformed/absent → default)

note_absent in binding_lifecycle.py must replace _env_int("RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE", ...) with resolve_absent_retire_grace() imported from rebar.config to match the established pattern used by fetcher.py and applier.py
the _env_int helper must be removed entirely once note_absent is rewired, eliminating the ambient os.environ read below the seam
_DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained (not an ambient read, still aliased by binding_store.py and asserted by tests)
upon completion, scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS will be empty, config_ownership gate clean, and absence-retire behavior byte-preserved
